title: A filter argument that selects no rows makes SUM return BLANK

source.quote: The result is blank in case there are no rows in the table with a non-blank value.
source.supports: SUM is blank when no rows are visible

derivation: No product is Purple, so no Sales row is visible and SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) is BLANK, not 0. ROW still returns its one row.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: the only value is BLANK.
